policy.purpose: Persist first-party reconciliation hints for roles explicitly kept by the user when the mapped ATS inventory/search does not enumerate them.
policy.verification: Open/closed lifecycle must be established from a current first-party inventory whenever available. Historical vacancy/detail pages are not sufficient evidence that a role remains open.
policy.lifecycle: These records are reconciliation hints only; user_job_decisions.json remains authoritative for TO_REVIEW/INTERESTED/APPLIED/NOT_INTERESTED. A CLOSED lifecycle does not delete or rewrite the user's historical decision.
